וְנִזְכֶּה לְבָרֵר הַפַּרְנָסָה בִּקְדֻשָּׁה וּבְטָהֳרָה גְּדוֹלָה בִּבְחִינַת קְטֹרֶת הַמְשַׂמֵּחַ אֶת הַלֵּב.


May we purify our income with great holiness and purity, corresponding to the incenseoffering, which gives joy to the heart.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 17:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/17:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/17:22)


וְתָבִיא לָנוּ אֶת מְשִׁיחַ צִדְקֵנוּ בִּמְהֵרָה בְּיָמֵינוּ, וְיִמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל כָּל הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ,


Bring us our righteous Mashiach quickly, in our days. May he rule over us, over all of the Jewish people, and over the entire world.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 17:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/17:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/17:23)


וִיקֻיַּם בָּנוּ מְהֵרָה מִקְרָא שֶׁכָּתוּב, מֶלֶךְ בְּיָפְיוֹ תֶּחֱזֶינָה עֵינֶיךָ תִּרְאֶינָה אֶרֶץ מַרְחַקִּים. בִּמְהֵרָה בְּיָמֵינוּ, אָמֵן כֵּן יְהִי רָצוֹן:


May the verse quickly be realized in us, “Your eyes shall see the King in His beauty; they will see from a distant land” — quickly, in our days. Amen. May it be Your will.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:1)


[עַל־פִּי תּוֹרָה י"ז בְּסוֹפָהּ - דֶּרֶךְ הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ – לְהַבִּיט עַל הַטּוֹבוֹת שֶׁעוֹשִׂין]
רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, דַּרְכְּךָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְהַאֲרִיךְ אַפֶּךָ לָרָעִים וְלַטּוֹבִים, וְהִיא תְהִלָּתֶךָ.


*God Looks Only at the Good in Us / Seeing the Good in Others / God Sometimes Relates to Us Through Providence and Sometimes Through Nature*
[Both Prayers 13 and 18 are based on Rebbe Nachman’s lesson in *Likutey Moharan* II, 17. That lesson consists of two distinct parts; therefore, Reb Noson wrote Prayer 13 focusing on the topic of Shabbat, and Prayer 18 focusing on the topic of Divine providence.]
God looks at the good that we do and ignores anything untoward that it might contain. (In the same way, we, too, may not view others negatively and seek to find their flaws. To the contrary, we must look only at the good.)
That is why God created a world with both providence and nature. When a person does something good, God guides him with providence. If he does something wrong, God lets nature take its course. If only providence existed, when God would see that people aren’t acting correctly, He would grow angry and eliminate His providence — which is a sign of His care — entirely. But now, at such times, He leaves people to nature. And when they improve, God again exercises providence over them.
However, there is a paradox here that we as human beings cannot understand — which is that we cannot differentiate between nature and providence, since nature itself is God’s providence.
**God’s Compassion**
God, Master of the world, it is Your way to be patient with both wicked and good people — and that constitutes Your praise.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:2)


מָלֵא רַחֲמִים טוֹב וּמֵטִיב לַכֹּל, אֲשֶׁר דַּרְכְּךָ לְהֵיטִיב לִבְרִיּוֹתֶיךָ, וְאַתָּה מַטֶּה כְּלַפֵּי חֶסֶד תָּמִיד,


You Who are filled with compassion, You Who are good and do good to all, it is Your way to do good for Your creatures. You tend toward lovingkindness always.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:3)


וְאֵין אַתָּה חָפֵץ לְהַבִּיט וּלְהִסְתַּכֵּל עַל הָרַע וְהָאָוֶן שֶׁאָנוּ עוֹשִׂין חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, רַק אַתָּה מַבִּיט וּמַשְׁגִּיחַ עַל מְעַט הַטּוֹב שֶׁאַתָּה מוֹצֵא בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ בַּחֲסָדֶיךָ הָעֲצוּמִים,


You do not desire to look at and see the evil and sins that we commit, Heaven forbid. Rather, in Your mighty lovingkindness, You gaze upon and look at the little bit of good that You find within us.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:4)


כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל, יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ, וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ. וְנֶאֱמַר: אָוֶן אִם רָאִיתִי בְלִבִּי לֹא יִשְׁמַע יְהֹוָה, אָכֵן שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים, הִקְשִׁיב בְּקוֹל תְּפִלָּתִי.


As the verse states, “He has not gazed upon sin in Jacob and has not seen weariness in Israel; HaShem his God is with him, and the friendship of the King is with him.” And, “If I have seen sin in my heart, HaShem does not hear it. But God has heard and taken heed of the voice of my prayer.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:5)


עַל כֵּן מָצָא עַבְדְּךָ אֶת לִבּוֹ עֲדַיִן לְהִתְפַּלֵּל לְפָנֶיךָ, וַעֲדַיִן עֲדַיִן עַל מִשְׁמַרְתִּי אֶעֱמֹדָה וַאֲצַפֶּה לִישׁוּעָתְךָ הָאֲמִתִּיִּית, מָתַי תָּבוֹא אֵלַי שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לָשׁוּב אֵלֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת,


Therefore, I, Your servant, have found it possible to offer You my heartfelt prayer. And I continue to stand and hope for Your true salvation. When will it come to me so that I will truly return to You?


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:6)


אֲשֶׁר עַל זֶה בִּקַּשְׁתִּי מִלְּפָנֶיךָ זֶה כַּמָּה, בְּכַמָּה לְשׁוֹנוֹת שֶׁל תְּפִלָּה וְתַחֲנוּנִים, וַעֲדַיִן לֹא נוֹשַׁעְתִּי, וַאֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ שֶׁהַמְּנִיעָה מִמֶּנִּי, אֲבָל עַל טוּבְךָ הַגָּדוֹל אֲנִי נִשְׁעָן עֲדַיִן,


I have begged You so long regarding this, with so many expressions of prayer and pleading, but I still have not been saved. I know that the obstacle comes from within me — but I rely on Your great goodness.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:7)


שֶׁתָּצִיץ וְתַבִּיט וְתַשְׁגִּיחַ עַל מְעַט דִּמְעַט נְקֻדּוֹת טוֹבוֹת הַנִּמְצָאִים בִּי עֲדַיִן, וְתַעְלִים עֵינֶיךָ מִלִּרְאוֹת וּלְהִסְתַּכֵּל עַל רִבּוּי וְעֹצֶם הָרַע שֶׁבִּי, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁתַּכְנִיעַ וּתְבַטֵּל רִבּוּי הָרַע לְגַבֵּי מְעַט הַטּוֹב שֶׁבִּי.


Peer, gaze and look at the very few good points that still exist within me. Turn Your eyes from seeing and looking at the multitude and magnitude of the evil within me. Subdue and nullify that evil, which is so considerable when compared to the little amount of good within me.

וּבְכֹחֲךָ הַגָּדוֹל תִּתֵּן כֹּחַ לִמְעַט הַטּוֹב שֶׁבִּי שֶׁיִּתְגַּבֵּר עַל הָרַע שֶׁבִּי, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה מֵעַתָּה לָשׁוּב בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת,


In Your great power, empower the little amount of good within me so that it will overcome the evil. From now on may I truly return to You in complete repentance.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:9)


וְתֵטִיב עִמִּי בְּחַסְדְּךָ בְּכָל עֵת בְּגַשְׁמִיּוּת וְרוּחָנִיּוּת, לֹא כִגְמוּלִי וּכְמַעֲשֵׂי יָדַי הַפְּגוּמִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, רַק כְּחַסְדְּךָ וּכְטוּבְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וּכְרַחֲמָנוּתְךָ הֶעָצוּם, אֲשֶׁר אֵין אַתָּה מַבִּיט עַל הָרַע כִּי אִם עַל מְעַט הַטּוֹב. וְאַל תִּמְנַע טוֹב מִמֶּנִּי מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם:


In Your lovingkindness, always send me goodness in the material and spiritual realms — not in accordance with what I and the blemished work of my hands deserve, Heaven forbid, but in accordance with Your lovingkindness, Your great goodness and Your mighty compassion, as a result of which You do not gaze at the evil in me but at the little bit of good. Do not withhold goodness from me, from now and forevermore.

וּתְרַחֵם עָלַי וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְתִתֶּן לִי דַעַת שָׁלֵם דִּקְדֻשָּׁה, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לְהִתְדַבֵּק בִּדְרָכֶיךָ הַקְּדוֹשִׁים,


Have compassion on me and on the entire Jewish people. Give me a perfected, holy consciousness so that I will cling to Your holy ways.

לְבַל אֶסְתַּכֵּל וְאַבִּיט עַל הָרַע שֶׁל שׁוּם בַּר יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם, וְלֹא אָשִׂים עֵינַי כְּלָל עַל מַעֲשָׂיו וּמִדּוֹתָיו שֶׁאֵינָם טוֹבִים,


**Seeing the Good in Others**
May I not look or gaze at the evil within any Jew in the world. May I not turn my eyes to any of his deeds or traits that are not good.

רַק אֶזְכֶּה לָדוּן אֶת כָּל אָדָם לְכַף זְכוּת, וּלְהִסְתַּכֵּל רַק עַל הַטּוֹב שֶׁל כָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל, וְלֹא אֶסְתַּכֵּל עַל הָרַע שֶׁלּוֹ כְּלָל.


May I judge every Jew favorably and only look at the good in him. May I not look at the evil in him at all.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:13

וּבְרַחֲמֶיךָ וַחֲסָדֶיךָ הָרַבִּים תִּפְקַח אֶת עֵינֵי דַעְתִּי, וְתִתֶּן לִי דַּעַת שָׁלֵם דִּקְדֻשָּׁה, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לְחַפֵּשׂ וּלְבַקֵּשׁ וְלִמְצֹא זְכוּת וָטוֹב בְּכָל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל, אֲפִלּוּ בְּהַגָּרוּעַ שֶׁבַּגְּרוּעִים.


In Your vast compassion and lovingkindness, open my mind’s eye and give me a perfected, holy consciousness so that I will seek, search for and find merit and goodness in every Jew — even in the least of the least.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:14

וְאֶזְכֶּה לִרְאוֹת וּלְהַבִּיט רַק עַל הַטּוֹב שֶׁבְּכָל אֶחָד, וְלֹא אַבִּיט וְאֶסְתַּכֵּל עַל הָרַע שֶׁבָּהֶם כְּלָל.


May I see and gaze solely at the good in everyone, and not gaze or look at any evil in anyone.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:15

וְתִתֶּן לִי עַיִן יָפָה וְטוֹבָה לְהַבִּיט עַל כָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל לְטוֹבָה, אֶת הַטּוֹב שֶׁבּוֹ אֲקַבֵּל בְּדַעְתִּי לְהִסְתַּכֵּל עָלָיו, וְאֶת הָרַע לֹא אֲקַבֵּל, וְלֹא אָשִׁית עֵינַי עָלָיו כְּלָל,


Give me a beautiful and good eye with which to gaze at every Jew for the good. May I resolve to look only at the good in him and not the evil at all.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:16

לְמַעַן אֶזְכֶּה לִהְיוֹת טוֹב וְיָשָׁר גַּם עִם יְהֹוָה וְעִם אֲנָשִׁים, וְאֶמְצָא חֵן וְשֵׂכֶל טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי אֱלֹהִים וְאָדָם,


May I be good and straight in Your eyes, HaShem, and in the eyes of people. May I “find favor and good understanding in the eyes of God and man.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:17

בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁאוּכַל לְהִתְוָעֵד עִם כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל, לְדַבֵּר עִמָּהֶם בֶּאֱמֶת לַאֲמִתּוֹ מֵהַתַּכְלִית הָאֲמִתִּי, וּלְקַבֵּל מִנְּקֻדָּתָם הַטּוֹבָה לְהִתְעוֹרֵר וְלָשׁוּב לַיהֹוָה,


May I meet every Jew and speak with him in ultimate truth about the true purpose, and appreciate his good points, so that I will be inspired to return to You, HaShem.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:18)


וּלְהָאִיר בָּהֶם מִנְּקֻדָּתִי הַטּוֹבָה, וּלְחוֹנֵן אוֹתָם בַּאֲמִתַּת הַדַּעַת שֶׁל נְקֻדָּתִי הַטּוֹבָה, לְהוֹדִיעָם אֶת כָּל הַטּוֹב הַנִּצְפָּן בִּי מִקְּדֻשַּׁת יִשְׂרָאֵל.


May I illuminate others with the good in myself and grace them with my true awareness that comes from the good within myself, sharing with them all of the good hidden in me by virtue of the fact that I possess the holiness of being a Jew.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:19)


חוּס וַחֲמֹל עָלַי וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, לְמַעַן שִׁמְךָ וּלְמַעַן צַדִּיקֶיךָ הָאֲמִתִּיִּים וּלְמַעַן תּוֹרָתְךָ הַקְּדוֹשָׁה, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַנְךָ וְלֹא לְמַעֲנֵנוּ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַנְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ, וְהַחֲזִירֵנוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶיךָ.


Have pity and mercy on me and on the entire Jewish people for the sake of Your Name, for the sake of Your true Tzaddikim, and for the sake of Your holy Torah. Act for Your sake and for our sake. Act for Your sake and save us. Bring us back to You in complete repentance.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:20)


חוּסָה עָלַי כָּל עוֹד נַפְשִׁי בִּי, כִּי כְבָר פָּנָה יוֹם, וּכְבָר עָבְרוּ מִשְּׁנוֹתַי מַה שֶּׁעָבְרוּ, וַעֲדַיִן לֹא עָבַר עָלַי שָׁנָה אַחַת וְלֹא יוֹם אֶחָד בְּלִי פְּגָמִים הַרְבֵּה.


Have pity on me as long as my soul is within me. The day has waned and my years have passed, and not one year or one day has passed without my causing a great deal of blemishes.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:21)


רַחֵם עָלַי מֵעַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת מְעַט פְּלֵטָתִי הַנִּשְׁאֶרֶת, שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה מֵעַתָּה בְּכֹחֲךָ לְהַגְבִּיר הַטּוֹב עַל הָרָע, כִּי מְעַט מִן הָאוֹר דּוֹחֶה הַרְבֵּה מִן הַחֹשֶׁךְ.


Have compassion on me from now on to revive the small remnant that remains of me, so that from now on, with Your help, I will overcome the evil with good, because a little light repels a great deal of darkness.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 18:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/18:22)


אַל תִּטְּשֵׁנִי וְאַל תַּעַזְבֵנִי אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי, אַל תֶּאֱסֹף עִם חַטָּאִים נַפְשִׁי וְעִם אַנְשֵׁי דָמִים חַיָּי, אַל תַּעַזְבֵנִי יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהַי אַל תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי, חוּשָׁה לְעֶזְרָתִי אֲדֹנָי תְּשׁוּעָתִי:


“Do not forsake me and do not abandon me, God of my salvation.” “Do not gather my soul with sinners, or my life with men of blood.” “Do not abandon me, HaShem; my God, do not be far from me. Hurry to help me, God, my salvation.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:1)


[עַל־פִּי תּוֹרָה כ' - עַל־יְדֵי הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּעוֹלָם, נַעֲשִׂין מְפֻרְסָמִים קֹדֶם זְמַנָּם]
שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה חַיִּים חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ.


*Dispute Makes a Person Prematurely Famous, Harming Him and His Cause*
When a person begins serving God, he needs to wait a proper amount of time until he becomes known as a Torah leader. But dispute causes damage that results in such a person becoming prematurely known. This premature fame then harms that person or the way of serving God that he wanted to promulgate.
It may even happen that people engaged in dispute die. And even if the harm is not that bad, the dispute causes poverty.
**Loving Peace and Pursuing Peace**
Give us and Your entire nation, the Jewish people, peace, goodness, blessing, life, graciousness, kindness and compassion.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:2)


אֲדוֹן הַשָּׁלוֹם מֶלֶךְ שֶׁהַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁלּוֹ, בָּרְכֵנוּ בַשָּׁלוֹם, וְתִפְקְדֵנִי אוֹתִי וְאֶת כָּל בְּנֵי־בֵיתִי, לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם, וְתַצִּילֵנוּ מִן הָעֲנִיּוּת וּמִן הַחֹסֶר.


Master of peace, King Who possesses peace, bless us with peace. Grant me and everyone in my family a good life and peace. Rescue us from poverty and want.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:3)


רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְשָׁמְרֵנוּ וְהַצִּילֵנוּ מִן הָרִיב וּמַחֲלֹקֶת, כִּי אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ כַּמָּה שָׂנוּא הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת וְגָדוֹל הַשָּׁלוֹם.


Master of the world, have compassion on us and on the entire Jewish people. Guard us and deliver us from argument and dispute. You know how hateful dispute is, and how great is peace.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:4

לַמְּדֵנִי וְהוֹרֵנִי אֵיךְ לְהִתְנַהֵג עִם כָּל בָּאֵי עוֹלָם, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לִהְיוֹת בְּשָׁלוֹם יַחְדָּו עִם כָּל בְּנֵי תֵבֵל, וַאֲפִלּוּ עִם הַחוֹלְקִים עָלַי,


Teach me and show me how to treat all people, so that I will be at with peace with everyone in the world.

תִּתֵּן בְּלִבִּי דֶרֶךְ וְעֵצָה אֲמִתִּיִּית כִּרְצוֹנְךָ הַטּוֹב, שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לֵידַע אֵיךְ לְהִתְנַהֵג עִמָּהֶם עִם כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁלֹּא אַחֲזִיק בְּמַחֲלֹקֶת,


Show my heart a path and give it true counsel, in accordance with Your good will, so that I will know how to treat people, even those who dispute me, and so that I myself will not engage in dispute.

רַק אֶזְכֶּה לִהְיוֹת תָּמִיד אוֹהֵב שָׁלוֹם וְרוֹדֵף שָׁלוֹם בֶּאֱמֶת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב בַּקֵּשׁ שָׁלוֹם וְרָדְפֵהוּ.


May I always truly love peace and pursue peace. As the verse states, “Turn aside from evil and do good. Seek peace and pursue it.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:7

וּתְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְתִשְׁמְרֵנוּ שֶׁלֹּא יִגְרֹם הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם לְפַרְסֵם חַס וְשָׁלוֹם מְפֻרְסָמִים קֹדֶם זְמַנָּם, כִּי אַתָּה הוֹדַעְתָּנוּ בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ, גֹּדֶל הַפְּגַם וְהַהֶפְסֵד הַמַּגִּיעַ מִזֶּה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם:


**May No Jew Become Prematurely Famous**
Have compassion on us and guard us so that dispute will not cause people to gain fame before their time, Heaven forbid. In Your compassion, You have informed us of the great blemish and loss that results when that occurs, Heaven forbid.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:8

רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, וְזַכֵּנוּ אוֹתָנוּ וְאֶת כָּל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעָזְרֵנוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ בְּכָל־עֵת, שֶׁכָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד יֵלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ הַיָּשָׁר, בְּדֶרֶךְ הָאֱמֶת, בְּדֶרֶךְ הַקֹּדֶשׁ, כְּפִי אֲשֶׁר הוֹרוּנוּ וְלִמְּדוּנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ הַקְּדוֹשִׁים,


Have compassion on us for the sake of Your Name. Help us and Your entire nation, the House of Israel. Save us at every moment, so that every individual will go upon the straight, true way, the way of holiness, as our forefathers and holy rabbis have guided and taught us.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:9

עַד אֲשֶׁר כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד יִזְכֶּה לְגַלּוֹת וּלְהָאִיר בָּעוֹלָם אֶת הַדֶּרֶךְ הַקֹּדֶשׁ הָאֱמֶת שֶׁהוּא הוֹלֵךְ בּוֹ,


May every individual reveal the true, holy way upon which he proceeds and cause it to shine in the world.

לְגַלּוֹת בְּכָל פַּעַם עֵצוֹת וּדְרָכִים חֲדָשִׁים, קְדוֹשִׁים וּטְהוֹרִים אֲמִתִּיִּים, אֵיךְ לִזְכּוֹת לְהִתְקָרֵב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בֶּאֱמֶת.


May everyone constantly discover new, holy, pure, true advice and ways in which to truly come close to You, HaShem.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:11)


וְתָגֵן עָלֵינוּ וְתִשְׁמְרֵנוּ תָמִיד שֶׁלֹּא יִתְפַּרְסֵם שׁוּם אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל קֹדֶם זְמַנּוֹ,


Shield us and guard us always so that no Jew will gain fame before his time.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:12)


רַק כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד יִזְכֶּה לֵילֵךְ וְלִכְנֹס בְּדֶרֶךְ הַקֹּדֶשׁ בֶּאֱמֶת, וְלֵילֵךְ וְלִדְרֹךְ בּוֹ יָמִים וְשָׁנִים בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְלֵב שָׁלֵם, בְּתוֹסֶפֶת קְדֻשָּׁה וְטָהֳרָה וְחַיּוּת חָדָשׁ וְהִתְעוֹרְרוּת חָדָשׁ וְנִפְלָא בְּכָל־עֵת.


Rather, may each individual go forward and enter upon the way of true holiness. May he proceed and walk upon that path for days and years, sincerely and wholeheartedly, at every moment increasing holiness, purity, new life and new, wondrous inspiration.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:13)


וְנִזְכֶּה לְהִתְמַהְמֵהַּ וְלִשְׁהוֹת שָׁם בְּדֶרֶךְ הַקֹּדֶשׁ הָאֲמִתִּי, זְמַן הָרָאוּי בֶּאֱמֶת, וּלְהִתְחַמֵּם שָׁם בְּהִתְלַהֲבוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה כָּרָאוּי, עַד שֶׁיַּגִּיעַ הַזְּמַן וְהָעֵת הָרָאוּי בֶּאֱמֶת לְגַלּוֹת וּלְהוֹדִיעַ וּלְפַרְסֵם הַדֶּרֶךְ הַקֹּדֶשׁ בָּעוֹלָם,


May we wait and remain there in the way of true holiness for the necessary length of time, warming ourselves with an appropriate amount of holy fervor, until the truly right time and season will come for us to reveal, teach and publicize the holy path in the world.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:14)


וְלֹא יִתְפַּרְסֵם שׁוּם אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל קֹדֶם זְמַנּוֹ. וְתִשְׁמְרֵנוּ וְתַצִּילֵנוּ מִכָּל מִינֵי הֶזֵּקוֹת וְצַעַר וְיִסּוּרִין הַבָּאִים עַל־יְדֵי־זֶה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם,


May no Jew become prematurely famous. Guard us and rescue us from all sorts of damage, suffering and adversity that come as a result of that, Heaven forbid.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:15)


וְתַמְשִׁיךְ עָלֵינוּ חַיִּים טוֹבִים וַאֲרוּכִּים, וְלֹא יָמוּת שׁוּם אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל קוֹדֶם זְמַנּוֹ.


Send us a good, long life. May no Jew die before his time. Rather, may every individual experience many good days and years in Torah, prayer and good deeds.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:16

רַק כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד יִזְכֶּה לְהַאֲרִיךְ יָמִים וְשָׁנִים טוֹבִים בְּתוֹרָה וּתְפִלָּה וּמַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים, עַד שֶׁיִּזְכֶּה לְגַלּוֹת הַדֶּרֶךְ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּעוֹלָם כְּפִי חֶלְקוֹ שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ בְּהַתּוֹרָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה, כְּפִי שֹׁרֶשׁ נִשְׁמָתוֹ, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁיִּתְגַּלּוּ דַרְכֵי הַקְּדֻשָּׁה בָּעוֹלָם,


May each person at last reveal the path of holiness in the world, in accordance with his portion in the holy Torah, in accordance with the root of his soul, so that the ways of holiness will be revealed.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:17

וְיִתְגַּלּוּ וְיָאִירוּ בָּעוֹלָם כָּל הָעֵצוֹת הָעֲמוּקוֹת וְכָל הַדְּרָכִים הַחֲדָשִׁים וְהַנִּפְלָאִים שֶׁהִמְשִׁיכוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים בָּעוֹלָם מִיּוֹם מַתַּן־תּוֹרָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה, כֻּלָּם יָאִירוּ עַל פְּנֵי תֵבֵל, לָדַעַת בָּאָרֶץ דַּרְכֶּךָ בְּכָל גּוֹיִם יְשׁוּעָתֶךָ,


May all of the profound counsel and all of the new and wondrous paths that the Tzaddikim have drawn into the world since the giving of the Torah until this day be revealed and shine. May they all illuminate the face of the world “so that Your way will be known upon the earth, Your salvation among all of the nations.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:18

בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁנִּזְכֶּה כֻלָּנוּ אֲנַחְנוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵינוּ עַד סוֹף כָּל הַדּוֹרוֹת, לְהִתְקָרֵב אֵלֶיךָ תָמִיד בֶּאֱמֶת לַאֲמִתּוֹ, וְלֵילֵךְ בִּדְרָכֶיךָ הַקְּדוֹשִׁים, בְּדַרְכֵי הַצַּדִּיקִים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים הַגְּדוֹלִים וְהַנּוֹרָאִים, זְכוּתָם יָגֵן עָלֵינוּ, לְקָרְבֵנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת מְהֵרָה.


In that way, may we all — we and our offspring until the end of all generations — come close to You always in ultimate truth and walk in Your holy ways, in the ways of the great and awesome true Tzaddikim, so that we will truly come close to You quickly.

וְתִתֶּן לָנוּ פַּרְנָסוֹתֵינוּ בְּהַרְחָבָה גְּדוֹלָה מֵאִתְּךָ, וְתִשְׁמְרֵנוּ וְתַצִּילֵנוּ מִן הָעֲנִיּוּת וְהַדַּחֲקוּת, וְלֹא יִצְטָרְכוּ עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל זֶה לָזֶה וְלֹא לְעַם אַחֵר.


Send us our income with great breadth. Guard us and rescue us from poverty and want. May Your nation, the Jewish people, not be dependent on each other or on any other nation.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:20

רַק בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים, תַּשְׁפִּיעַ לָנוּ לְכָל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד פַּרְנָסָתוֹ וְכָל הִצְטָרְכוּתוֹ בְּהַרְחָבָה גְּדוֹלָה קֹדֶם שֶׁיִּצְטָרֵךְ לָהֶם בְּנַחַת וְלֹא בְּצַעַר, בְּהֶתֵּר וְלֹא בְּאִסּוּר, בְּכָבוֹד וְלֹא בְּבִזָּיוֹן.


Rather, in Your vast compassion, pour forth onto each and every individual his income and all that he needs with great breadth before he needs it — with ease and not with suffering, in a manner that is permitted and not forbidden, with honor and not with disgrace.

Shield us always so that dispute will not destroy us, Heaven forbid.

לְהַפִּיל נְפָלִים חָלִילָה. וְלֹא יַגִּיעַ שׁוּם הֶזֵּק וּפְגָּם לֹא לְדֶרֶךְ הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּעַצְמוֹ שֶׁצְּרִיכִין הַצַּדִּיקִים וְהַכְּשֵׁרִים לְגַלּוֹת בָּעוֹלָם בְּכָל עֵת, וְלֹא לְהָאֲנָשִׁים הַנִּכְנָסִים בּוֹ לְגַלּוֹתוֹ. וְלֹא תַפִּיל אִשָּׁה פְּרִי בִטְנָהּ (וּבִפְרָט לִפְלוֹנִי בַּת פְּלוֹנִית) וְלָא יַעְדֵּי עָבֵיד שׁוּלְטָן מִדְּבֵית יְהוּדָה:


May no damage or blemish affect the holy path that the Tzaddikim and worthy people must constantly reveal in the world, or affect the people who go upon that way in order to reveal it. May no woman miscarry the fruit of her womb (in particular, [Hebrew name], the daughter of [mother’s Hebrew name]). And may sovereignty never leave the House of Judah.

רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, מַלֵּא מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֵינוּ לְטוֹבָה בְּרַחֲמִים, כִּי צְרָכַי מְרֻבִּים מְאֹד, וְדַעְתִּי קְצָרָה לְבָאֵר וּלְפָרֵשׁ,


**God Loves Every Jew**
Master of the world, compassionately fulfill our requests for the good. My needs are many and my awareness is too abbreviated to explain and elucidate what I need.

There are a great many things in my heart to ask You for and to pray to You about.

אַךְ דַּעְתִּי עֲכוּרָה וְטַעֲנוֹתַי נִסְתַּתְּמִין, וְאֵינִי יָכוֹל לִפְרֹט בְּפִי כָּל צָרְכֵי בַּקָּשׁוֹתַי וְכָל מִשְׁאֲלוֹתַי שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּכָל דְּבַר קְדֻשָּׁה שֶׁאֲנִי עוֹסֵק לְהִתְפַּלֵּל עָלָיו,


But my mind is muddled and my arguments are impeded, and I cannot express in detail everything I need and all of my requests regarding every holy matter that I am praying for.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:26

אַךְ אַתָּה מֵבִין כָּל תַּעֲלוּמוֹת לֵב וְאַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ סְתָרֵינוּ.


But You understand all of the hidden matters of the heart, and You know our secret places.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:27

חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַנְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, וְהוֹרֵנוּ דְרָכֶיךָ, וְהַט לִבֵּנוּ לְיִרְאָה אֶת שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת.


You Who are gracious and compassionate, act for Your sake and save us for the sake of Your Name. Guide us in Your ways and direct our heart to truly fear Your Name.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:28

וְהַצִּילֵנוּ וְשָׁמְרֵנוּ מִכָּל מִינֵי רִיב וּמַחֲלֹקֶת וְשִׂנְאָה וְקִנְטוּר שֶׁנִּתְרַבֶּה בָּעוֹלָם מְאֹד בַּעֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ הָרַבִּים.


Rescue us and guard us from every type of argument, dispute, hatred, jealousy and hostility, which have increased greatly in the world because of our many sins.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:29

רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ לְמַעַן תּוֹרָתֶךָ, לְמַעַן אֲמִתַּת קְדֻשַּׁת הַצַּדִּיקִים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים, וְהַשְׁקֵט הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת מְהֵרָה, וְתָשִׂים שָׁלוֹם גָּדוֹל בֵּין כָּל הַבְּרוּאִים שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם, וּתְגַלֶּה הָאֱמֶת בָּעוֹלָם.


Have compassion on us for the sake of Your Name, for the sake of Your Torah, for the sake of the true holiness of the true Tzaddikim. Silence dispute quickly. Bring great peace between all created beings in the world, and reveal the truth.

וְתִשְׁלַח לָנוּ בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר צַדִּיקִים אֲמִתִּיִּים שֶׁיּוֹרוּ אוֹתָנוּ בְּכָל עֵת, הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר נֵלֵךְ בָּהּ וְאֶת הַמַּעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר נַעֲשֶׂה,


Send us true Tzaddikim in every generation who will guide us at every moment on the way that we should walk, and who will inform us of the deeds that we should perform.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:31

בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁנִּזְכֶּה כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד לָשׁוּב אֵלֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת מִכָּל הַמְּקוֹמוֹת וְהָעִנְיָנִים אֲשֶׁר נָפַל וְנִתְעָה בָּהֶם, וְאַל יִדַּח מִמְּךָ נִדָּח.


May every individual truly return to You from all of the places and areas in which he fell and went astray. And may no one remain rejected.

וְתִזְכֹּר אַהֲבָתְךָ וְרַחֲמָנוּתְךָ שֶׁיֵּשׁ לְךָ עַל־כָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל, אֲפִלּוּ עַל הַקַּל שֶׁבַּקַּלִּים וְהַגָּרוּעַ שֶׁבַּגְּרוּעִים, זְכֹר רַחֲמֶיךָ יְהֹוָה וַחֲסָדֶיךָ כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵמָּה,


Remember Your love and compassion for every individual Jew, even the slightest and the most unworthy. “Recall Your compassion, HaShem, and Your lovingkindness, because they are eternal.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:33)


וְאַל תַּעַזְבֵנוּ וְאַל תִּטְּשֵׁנוּ בַּדּוֹר הֶעָנִי הַזֶּה, וּשְׁלַח לָנוּ מַנְהִיגִים אֲמִתִּיִּים שֶׁיִּהְיוּ רְאוּיִים לְהַנְהִיג אוֹתָנוּ בֶּאֱמֶת כִּרְצוֹנְךָ הַטּוֹב, וְלֹא תִהְיֶה עֲדַת יְהֹוָה כַּצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר אֵין לָהֶם רֹעֶה.


Do not abandon us or spurn us in this poor generation. Send us genuine leaders who will be worthy of truly guiding us in accordance with Your good will. “May the congregation of HaShem not be like a flock of sheep that have no shepherd.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:34

חוּס וַחֲמֹל עָלֵינוּ, רַחֵם רַחֵם בַּעַל הָרַחֲמִים, הוֹרֵנִי יְהֹוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ אֲהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ, יַחֵד לְבָבִי לְיִרְאָה שְׁמֶךָ.


Have pity and mercy on us. Have compassion, Master of compassion! “HaShem, teach me Your ways. I will walk in Your truth. Unite my heart to fear Your Name.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:35)


הוֹרֵנִי יְהֹוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ וּנְחֵנִי בְּאֹרַח מִישׁוֹר לְמַעַן שׁוֹרְרָי. דְּרָכֶיךָ יְהֹוָה הוֹדִיעֵנִי אוֹרְחוֹתֶיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי. הַדְרִיכֵנִי בַאֲמִתֶּךָ וְלַמְּדֵנִי כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי, אוֹתְךָ קִוִּיתִי כָּל הַיּוֹם.


“HaShem, teach me Your ways. Guide me on a path that is straight, despite [my enemies] who gaze upon me.” “Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; it is for You that I have hoped all the day.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/19:36)


הוֹרֵנִי יְהֹוָה דֶּרֶךְ חֻקֶּיךָ וְאֶצֳּרֶנָּה עֵקֶב. הַדְרִיכֵנִי בִּנְתִיב מִצְוֹתֶיךָ כִּי בוֹ חָפָצְתִּי.


“HaShem, teach me the way of Your laws, and I will keep it at every step.” “Lead me upon the pathway of Your commandments, for I have desired it.”

יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי־פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי.


“May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing before You, HaShem, my Rock and my Redeemer.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 19:38

עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא בְּרַחֲמָיו יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:


May He Who makes peace in His heights, in His compassion make peace upon us and upon all Israel, and say, “Amen.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:1)


[עַל־פִּי תּוֹרָה כ"ב - בְּעִנְיַן הַהַכְנָעָה טוֹעִים הָעוֹלָם הַרְבֵּה]
**לְז' אֲדָר הִילּוּלָא דְּמֹשֶׁה רַבֵּנוּ ע"ה**


*Humility Requires an Expanded State of Consciousness*
Many people are mistaken about the meaning of humility.
We work very hard to overcome our smallmindedness and enter into an expanded state of consciousness. So humility cannot simply be a state of feeling small, because that is small-mindedness. Humility must involve an expanded state of consciousness.
Thus, not everyone has the wherewithal to be humble. Humility is so difficult a skill that Moses is praised for having possessed this trait, being called the humblest of all people (Numbers 12:3). As for unworthy humility, that is a species of fawning.
**For the Seventh of Adar, the Hilula of Moses**


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:2)


רָם וְנִשָּׂא שׁוֹכֵן עַד וְקָדוֹשׁ שְׁמוֹ, מָרוֹם וְקָדוֹשׁ תִּשְׁכֹּן, וְאֶת דַּכָּא וּשְׁפַל רוּחַ, לְהַחֲיוֹת רוּחַ שְׁפָלִים וּלְהַחֲיוֹת לֵב נִדְכָּאִים.


**The Ways of True Humility**
“Elevated and Exalted One, dwelling forever, holy is His Name. You dwell with the uplifted and holy, and with the crushed and lowly in spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble and to revive the heart of the crushed.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:3)


זַכֵּנִי בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים לְהָפִיק דַּרְכֵי הָעֲנָוָה הָאֲמִתִּיִּית בֶּאֱמֶת לַאֲמִתּוֹ כִּרְצוֹנְךָ הַטּוֹב, כִּי בַעַר אָנֹכִי מֵאִישׁ וְלֹא בִינַת אָדָם לִי, וְאֵין אִתִּי יוֹדֵעַ עַד מָה שׁוּם דֶּרֶךְ מִדַּרְכֵי הָעֲנָוָה הָאֲמִתִּיִּית,


In Your vast compassion, help me realize the ways of true humility in ultimate truth, in accordance with Your good will, even though “I am more animal than man, and I lack human understanding,” and I do not know anyone who knows much of any of the ways of true humility.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:4)


כִּי כְּבָר גִּלִּיתָ לָנוּ רְצוֹנְךָ הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁאֵין רְצוֹנְךָ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה הָאָדָם בְּמֹחִין דְּקַטְנוּת, וּצְרִיכִין לְהַכְרִיחַ אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּכָל הַכֹּחוֹת, בְּכָל הָעֲבוֹדוֹת, וּבִפְרָט בִּשְׁעַת הַתְּפִלָּה, לָצֵאת מִמֹּחִין דְּקַטְנוּת לְמֹחִין דְּגַדְלוּת.


You revealed to us that it is Your holy will that a person not remain in a state of constricted consciousness. He must exert himself with all his might in every type of worship that he engages in — particularly, prayer — to emerge from constricted consciousness to expanded consciousness.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:5)


וְגַם כְּבָר גִּלִּיתָ לָנוּ גֹדֶל בִּזּוּי הַגַּדְלוּת שֶׁהוּא שָׂנוּא בְּעֵינֶיךָ מְאֹד, כִּי הַגַּדְלוּת וְהַגַּבְהוּת הוּא תוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂנֵא, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, תּוֹעֲבַת יְהֹוָה כָּל גְּבַהּ־לֵּב, וְנֶחְשָׁב כְּעוֹבֵד עֲבוֹדָה־זָרָה וְכַאֲשֵׁרָה.


You have also revealed to us the great ignominy of egotism. It is hateful in Your eyes. Ego and haughtiness are an abomination to You, HaShem, something that You hate. As the verse states, “Everyone with a haughty heart is an abomination to HaShem.” Such a person is considered like an idolater, and like an object of idolatry itself.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:6)


וְעַתָּה לַמְּדֵנִי וְהוֹרֵנִי אֵיךְ יִזְכֶּה בַּעַר וְנַעַר וַחֲסַר דֵּעָה כָּמוֹנִי, לֵידַע דֶּרֶךְ הָאֱמֶת בָּזֶה, אֵיךְ לְהִתְנַהֵג בָּזֶה,


Teach me and guide me so that I will know how a person as boorish, callow and ignorant as myself may learn the way of truth in this area, how to act in this regard.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:7)


בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל בְּכַוָּנַת הַלֵּב בְּשִׂמְחָה, בְּמֹחִין דְּגַדְלוּת, שֶׁיִּגְבַּהּ לִבִּי בְּדַרְכֵי יְהֹוָה, וְאַף־עַל־פִּי־כֵן לֹא יִהְיֶה בְּלִבִּי שׁוּם צַד גֵּאוּת וְגַדְלוּת וּפְנִיּוֹת,


May I pray with a focused heart, with joy, with expanded consciousness, so that my heart will be uplifted in Your ways, HaShem, yet not possess any egotism, pride or untoward ambitions.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:8)


רַק אֶזְכֶּה לַעֲנָוָה אֲמִתִּיִּית כִּרְצוֹנְךָ הַטּוֹב, לַעֲנָוָה שֶׁל מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּנוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם, שֶׁהָיָה עָנָו מְאֹד מִכֹּל הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה:


In accordance with Your good will, may I attain true humility, the humility of Moses, who was much “more humble than anyone else upon the face of the earth.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:9)


רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ כַּמָּה בִּלְבּוּלִים בְּלִי שִׁעוּר יֵשׁ לִי בְּעִנְיָן זֶה, וּבִפְרָט בִּשְׁעַת הַתְּפִלָּה.


Master of the world, You know how much immeasurable confusion I have experienced regarding this matter — in particular, when it comes to prayer.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:10)


כִּי אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ שׁוּם דֶּרֶךְ בְּעִנְיָן זֶה שֶׁל הַהַכְנָעָה וְהָעֲנָוָה, אֵיךְ לְהִנָּצֵל מֵעֲנָוָה פְּסוּלָה הַנִּקְרֵאת חֲנוּפָּה, וְלִבְלִי לִפֹּל בְּדַעְתִּי כְּלָל לְעוֹלָם, וּלְהִתְחַזֵּק בְּכָל עֹז בְּעַזּוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה בְּכָל מַה שֶּׁאֲנִי צָרִיךְ לְהִתְחַזֵּק,


In regard to the topic of subservience and humility, I do not know how to avoid false humility, which is sycophancy, or how to avoid growing discouraged and how to strengthen myself with all my might to attain “holy insolence” whenever I need to bolster myself.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:11)


הֵן בֵּינִי לְבֵין עַצְמִי לְבַל אֶפֹּל בְּדַעְתִּי כְּלָל, רַק לְהִתְחַזֵּק בְּשִׂמְחָה בְּעֹז וְחֶדְוָה תָמִיד, וְחֶדְוַת יְהֹוָה יִהְיֶה מְעֻזִּי.


May I never collapse inwardly, but always encourage myself with joy, might and gladness, so that the gladness of HaShem will be my fortress.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:12)


וְהֵן בְּעִנְיָן הַהַנְהָגָה עִם בְּנֵי הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁצְּרִיכִין לִהְיוֹת עַז וְחָזָק כַּנָּמֵר נֶגֶד כָּל הַמּוֹנְעִים וְהַמְבַלְבְּלִים וְהַמַּחֲלִישִׁים דַּעַת הָרוֹצִים לִכְנֹס בְּדַרְכֵי הַצַּדִּיקִים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים,


In regard to interpersonal relations, may all of us who want to enter into the ways of the true Tzaddikim be bold and strong as a leopard to overcome all obstacles, distractions and discouragement.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:13)


בִּפְרָט בָּעִתִּים הַלָּלוּ בְּדוֹרוֹת אֵלּוּ, בְּעוּקְבָא דִמְשִׁיחָא, אֲשֶׁר נִתְרַבָּה הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת וְהַקַּטֵּגוֹרְיָא וְהַסִּכְסוּכִים בֵּין הַתַּלְמִידֵי־חֲכָמִים וְהַנִּלְוִים אֲלֵיהֶם, וּבֵין כָּל הָעוֹלָם,


This is particularly important in this era, in these generations, in the time of the “footsteps of the Mashiach,” when disputes, denunciations and arguments among Torah sages and those who are attached to them have increased throughout the world.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:14)


עַד אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָאִים אֲפִלּוּ צַדִּיקִים וּכְשֵׁרִים שֶׁיְּכוֹלִים לְהַחֲלִישׁ דַּעַת הַמַּתְחִיל לִכְנֹס בַּעֲבוֹדַת יְהֹוָה, מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן הַהִתְגָּרוּת וְהַמְּנִיעוֹת שֶׁל שְׁאָר בְּנֵי הָעוֹלָם,


Now some Tzaddikim and worthy people even dishearten a person who is beginning to enter into the service of HaShem — and the snares and obstacles posed by other human beings are even greater.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:15)


אֲשֶׁר בְּעִנְיָן זֶה אָסוּר לְהָאָדָם לִהְיוֹת עָנָיו וְנִכְנָע וְשָׁפָל כְּנֶגְדָּם, אַדְרַבָּא, צָרִיךְ לִהְיוֹת עַז כַּנָּמֵר כְּנֶגְדָּם לְבַל יִמְנָעֵהוּ שׁוּם מוֹנֵעַ, וְאַל יוּכַל לְהַחֲלִישׁ דַּעְתּוֹ שׁוּם אָדָם שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם,


In this matter, a person may not be humble, subservient or meek before others. To the contrary, he must be as bold as a leopard so that no obstacle will thwart him and no one in the world will discourage him.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:16)


וְאַף־עַל־פִּי שֶׁהוּא יוֹדֵעַ בְּעַצְמוֹ שִׁפְלוּתוֹ וּפְחִיתוּתוֹ שֶׁהוּא גָּרוּעַ הַרְבֵּה מֵהַקָּמִים כְּנֶגְדּוֹ וְחוֹלְקִים עָלָיו וּמִתְלוֹצְצִים מִמֶּנּוּ וּמַחֲלִישִׁים דַּעְתּוֹ, אַף־עַל־פִּי־כֵן אָסוּר לוֹ לְהִתְבַּטֵּל כְּנֶגְדָּם,


Although he himself knows how lowly and worthless he is, that he is inferior to those who oppose him, dispute him, laugh at him and discourage him, nevertheless, he may not nullify himself before them.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:17)


אַדְרַבָּא, צָרִיךְ לְהִתְחַזֵּק כְּנֶגְדָּם בְּכָל עֹז, וְיֹאמַר, אַף־עַל־פִּי־כֵן גַּם אֲנִי רוֹצֶה לְהִתְקָרֵב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ!


To the contrary, he must strengthen himself against them with all his might, and say, “Nevertheless, I, too, want to come close to HaShem, may He be blessed.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:18)


כִּי הַצַּדִּיקִים הָעֲנָוִים בֶּאֱמֶת בִּבְחִינַת עֲנָוָה שֶׁל מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּנוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם, הַגְּדוֹלִים בְּמַעֲלָה מִכָּל גְּדוֹלֵי עוֹלָם, הֵם אוֹחֲזִים בְּיַד כָּל הַשְּׁפָלִים וְהָרְחוֹקִים, וּמְחַזְּקִים גַּם אוֹתִי לְהִתְקָרֵב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ.


“The truly humble Tzaddikim, whose humility is akin to that of the humility of Moses, who was greater in stature than all of the great leaders, hold the hand of all of those who are lowly and distant. They strengthen me as well to come close to HaShem.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:19)


וְעַתָּה אָבִי שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם, לַמְּדֵנִי וְהוֹרֵנִי וְחַזְּקֵנִי וְאַמְּצֵנִי אֵיךְ לִזְכּוֹת לָזֶה, שֶׁאֵדַע תָּמִיד פְּחִיתוּתִי וְשִׁפְלוּתִי בֶּאֱמֶת,


And now, my Father in Heaven, teach me, guide me, strengthen me and fortify me on how to attain this.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:20)


וְאַף־עַל־פִּי־כֵן אֶזְכֶּה לְהִתְחַזֵּק נֶגֶד כָּל הַמּוֹנְעִים וְהַמַּחֲלִישִׁים אֶת הַדַּעַת, יִהְיֶה מִי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה, וְלֹא אֶתְבַּטֵּל נֶגְדָּם כְּלָל.


Whatever may be, may I always know my true worthlessness and lowliness, yet nevertheless encourage myself against all who hinder me and discourage me. May I not allow myself to be subdued by them at all.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:21)


וְאֶזְכֶּה לְהַחֲיוֹת אֶת עַצְמִי תָמִיד בְּכָל הַנְּקֻדּוֹת טוֹבוֹת הַנִּמְצָאִים בִּי עֲדַיִן, וּבְכֹחַ הַצַּדִּיקִים הַגְּדוֹלִים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים הָאוֹחֲזִים בְּיָדֵינוּ תָמִיד, וּמְזָרְזִים וּמְחַזְּקִים אוֹתָנוּ לְהִתְקָרֵב וּלְהִשְׁתּוֹקֵק אֵלֶיךָ תָּמִיד בְּכָל עֵת יִהְיֶה אֵיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה, וְלִבְלִי לְהִסְתַּכֵּל עַל שׁוּם מוֹנֵעַ וּמְעַכֵּב וּמְבַלְבֵּל:


May I revive myself always with all of the good points that still exist within me, and with the power of the great, true Tzaddikim, who always grasp our hands and urge and strengthen us to come close to You and yearn for You always, at all times, whatever may be. May I take no heed of any obstacle, obstruction or distraction.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:22)


וְתַעַזְרֵנִי וּתְחַזְּקֵנִי וּתְאַמְּצֵנִי תָמִיד, עַד שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לְקָרֵב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ גַּם אֲנָשִׁים אֲחֵרִים, וּלְחַזְּקָם בַּעֲבוֹדָתְךָ וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת.


Help me, strengthen me and fortify me always, until I bring other people close to You, HaShem, and truly encourage them in Your service and in Your Torah.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:23)


כַּאֲשֶׁר הִזְהַרְתָּנוּ עַל זֶה עַל־יְדֵי צַדִּיקֶיךָ הָאֲמִתִּיִּים, שֶׁכָּל אָדָם מְחֻיָּב לַעֲסֹק בָּזֶה.


You have taught us through all of Your true Tzaddikim that every person is obligated to engage in this.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:24)


אָבִי שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם, יוֹדֵעַ מַחֲשָׁבוֹת, יוֹדֵעַ כָּל הַתַּעֲלוּמוֹת, אַתָּה לְבַד יוֹדֵעַ כַּמָּה יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים אֲנִי צָרִיךְ לִזְכּוֹת לְכָל זֶה, כִּי אֲנִי רָחוֹק מֵעֲנָוָה אֲמִתִּיִּית בְּתַכְלִית הָרִחוּק, כִּי עֲנָוָה גְּדוֹלָה מִכֻּלָּם.


My Father in Heaven, You Who know thoughts, You Who know all hidden things, You alone know how much salvation and compassion I need in order to attain all of this. For I am at the opposite extreme from true humility, which is the greatest attainment of all.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:25)


וּבְעֹצֶם רִחוּקִי מִמְּךָ, גַּם לְפָרֵשׁ שִׂיחָתִי לְפָנֶיךָ הֵיטֵב בְּעִנְיָן זֶה נִמְנַע מִמֶּנִּי מְאֹד. אַךְ אַף־עַל־פִּי־כֵן, מִמְּךָ לֹא יִפָּלֵא כָּל דָּבָר,


I am so far from You that it is simply impossible for me to adequately express myself to You concerning this. Nevertheless, nothing at all is beyond You.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:26)


כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, הֲיִפָּלֵא מֵיהֹוָה דָּבָר, הֵן כֹּל תּוּכָל וְלֹא יִבָּצֵר מִמְּךָ מְזִמָּה. וְאַתָּה יָכוֹל לְזַכּוֹת גַּם אוֹתִי לַעֲנָוָה אֲמִתִּיִּית.


As the verse states, “Is anything hidden from HaShem?” “You can do everything; no purpose can be withheld from You.” You can help even me attain true humility.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:27

וְתוֹרֵנִי וְתַדְרִיכֵנִי בַאֲמִתֶּךָ, וּתְלַמְּדֵנִי אֵיךְ לְהִתְנַהֵג עִם כָּל בָּאֵי עוֹלָם, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לִהְיוֹת קָטָן בְּעֵינַי מִכֻּלָּם וְלֵידַע שִׁפְלוּתִי בֶּאֱמֶת, וְאַף־עַל־פִּי־כֵן אֶהְיֶה עַז וְחָזָק לִבְלִי לְהִתְבַּטֵּל נֶגֶד שׁוּם מוֹנֵעַ וּמְבַלְבֵּל וּמַחֲלִישׁ דַּעַת.


In Your true manner, teach me and guide me. Teach me how to conduct myself with all people in such a way that I will be smaller in my eyes than all of them, and truly know how lowly I am. Yet at the same time, I will be bold and strong, and I will not nullify myself before any obstacle, distraction or discouragement.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:28)


זַכֵּנִי לְהַמְשִׁיךְ עָלַי קְדֻשַּׁת הָעֲנָוָה הָאֲמִתִּיִּית שֶׁל מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּנוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם, שֶׁהָיָה עָנָו מְאֹד מִכֹּל הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה. וְשָׁמְרֵנִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי מֵעֲנָוָה וְהַכְנָעָה שֶׁאֵינָהּ כִּרְצוֹנְךָ.


Help me draw onto myself the holy, true humility of Moses, who was “more humble than anyone else upon the face of the earth.” Protect me and rescue me from any type of humility or subservience that is not in accordance with Your will.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:29)


חָנֵּנִי מֵאִתְּךָ דֵּעָה בִּינָה וְהַשְׂכֵּל, לְבַל אַטְעֶה אֶת עַצְמִי כְּלָל בְּעִנְיָן הַהַכְנָעָה שֶׁטּוֹעִים בָּזֶה הָעוֹלָם הַרְבֵּה. לַמְּדֵנִי דֶּרֶךְ הָאֱמֶת לַאֲמִתּוֹ, שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לְכַוֵּן בָּזֶה וּבְכָל דָּבָר רְצוֹנְךָ הַטּוֹב בֶּאֱמֶת.


Graciously grant me knowledge, understanding and wisdom, so that I will never fool myself at all regarding the concept of subservience — something that people greatly misunderstand. Teach me the genuinely true path, so that I will discern Your good will in this and in everything else.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:30

זַכֵּנִי לְהִתְפַּלֵּל וְלַעֲבֹד אוֹתְךָ תָמִיד בֶּאֱמֶת בְּמֹחִין דְּגַדְלוּת בְּכָל־עֵת, בְּמֹחִין גְּדוֹלִים אֲמִתִּיִּים דִּקְדֻשָּׁה, שֶׁהֵם עִקָּר תַּכְלִית הָעֲנָוָה הָאֲמִתִּיִּית, כִּי בִּמְקוֹם גְּדֻלָּתוֹ שָׁם אַתָּה מוֹצֵא עַנְוְתָנוּתוֹ.


Grant me the ability to always pray and serve You with true, expanded holy consciousness at every moment. That is the essential goal of true humility, because “in the place of His greatness, there you find His humility.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:31)


עָזְרֵנִי עָזְרֵנִי, הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי, הַטֵּה יְהֹוָה אָזְנְךָ עֲנֵנִי, כִּי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנִי. כִּי אַתָּה עַם עָנִי תוֹשִׁיעַ וְעֵינַיִם רָמוֹת תַּשְׁפִּיל. כִּי יַצִּיל אֶבְיוֹן מְשַׁוֵּעַ וְעָנִי וְאֵין עוֹזֵר לוֹ. יָחוֹס עַל דַּל וְאֶבְיוֹן וְנַפְשׁוֹת אֶבְיוֹנִים יוֹשִׁיעַ.


Help me! Save me! “HaShem, incline Your ear, answer me, for I am poor and needy.” “You deliver the humble nation and cast down haughty eyes.” “He will rescue a needy person who cries out, and a poor person who has no one to help him. He will have mercy on the impoverished and needy, and He will save the souls of the needy.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:32)


עָזְרֵנִי כִּי עָלֶיךָ נִשְׁעָנְתִּי, עֲנֵנִי אָבִי שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם, כִּי לְךָ לְבַד הוֹחָלְתִּי, לְךָ לְבַד אֲנִי קוֹרֵא, לְךָ לְבַד אֲנִי מְצַפֶּה, לִישׁוּעָתְךָ לְבַד אֲנִי מְחַכֶּה,


Help me, because I rely on You. Answer me, my Father in Heaven, for I hope only in You. I call only to You. I look only to You. I await Your salvation alone.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:33)


לְרַחֲמֶיךָ הַגְּדוֹלִים וַחֲסָדֶיךָ הַגְּנוּזִים לְבַד תְּלוּיוֹת עֵינַי וְכָלוֹת אֲלֵיהֶם כָּל הַיּוֹם. אוּלַי יָחוֹס אוּלַי יְרַחֵם, אוּלַי יָחוֹס עַם עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אוּלַי יְרַחֵם. כִּי לֹא בָזָה וְלֹא שִׁקַּץ עֱנוּת עָנִי וְלֹא הִסְתִּיר פָּנָיו מִמֶּנּוּ, וּבְשַׁוְּעוֹ אֵלָיו שָׁמֵעַ.


The entire day, our eyes are raised and turn with yearning only to Your great compassion and hidden lovingkindness. Perhaps He will have pity! Perhaps He will be compassionate! Perhaps He will have mercy on a poor nation, and perhaps He will have compassion on the needy. “He did not despise and did not abhor the cry of the poor person, and did not hide His face from him, and heard his outcry to Him.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:34)


כָּל עַצְמוֹתַי תֹּאמַרְנָה יְהֹוָה מִי כָמוֹךָ, מַצִּיל עָנִי מֵחָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ וְעָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן מִגּוֹזְלוֹ. שַׁוְעַת עֲנִיִּים אַתָּה תִשְׁמַע, צַעֲקַת הַדַּל תַּקְשִׁיב וְתוֹשִׁיעַ.


“All of my bones will proclaim, ‘HaShem, who is like You? You rescue the poor person from the one stronger than he, and the impoverished and pauper from the person who robs him.’” You hear the wailing of the poor. You take heed of the outcry of the needy, and You save him.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:35)


תֶּן לִי מָגֵן יִשְׁעֶךָ וִימִינְךָ תִסְעָדֵנִי וְעַנְוָתְךָ תַרְבֵּנִי. רַחֲמָנָא דְּעָנֵי לַעֲנִיֵּי עֲנֵינָא, רַחֲמָנָא דְעָנֵי לִתְבִירֵי לִבָּא עֲנֵינָא, רַחֲמָנָא דְּעָנֵי לְמַכִּיכֵי רוּחָא עֲנֵינָא.


Give me “the shield of Your salvation and support me with Your right hand, and treat me with great humility.” Compassionate One Who answers the poor, answer me. Compassionate One Who answers the brokenhearted, answer me. Compassionate One Who answers the broken of spirit, answer me.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 20:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/20:36)


וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן, אֱלֹהִים חוּשָׁה לִּי, עֶזְרִי וּמְפַלְטִי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אַל תְּאַחַר. אָמֵן וְאָמֵן:


“I am poor and needy. God, hasten to me. You are my help and my rescuer. HaShem, do not delay!” Amen and amen.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:1)


[עַל־פִּי תּוֹרָה כ"ג - לַהֲפֹךְ יָגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְשִׂמְחָה]
שַׂמֵּחַ נֶפֶשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוָה נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּׂא. אָגִילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָה בְּחַסְדֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָ אֶת עָנְיִי יָדַעְתָּ בְּצָרוֹת נַפְשִׁי.


*Transforming Depression into Joy*
When people are happy and begin to dance, if they see a sad person standing off to the side, they pull him into the circle as he leaves his depression outside the circle.
But it is a greater accomplishment to pull depression itself into the circle and transform it into joy.
There is sadness from the Side of Evil that does not want to be a chariot for holiness. It therefore flees, and so it must be forced into holiness and joy.
**Strengthening and Increasing Joy**
“Give joy to the soul of Your servant — because, HaShem, I lift my soul to You!” “I will exult and rejoice in Your kindness, for You have seen my affliction. You have known the troubles of my soul.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:2)


תַּשְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה תָּגֵלְנָה עֲצָמוֹת דִּכִּיתָ. הָשִׁיבָה לִי שְׂשׂוֹן יִשְׁעֶךָ וְרוּחַ נְדִיבָה תִסְמְכֵנִי.


“Cause me to hear joy and gladness; may the bones that You crushed, exult.” “Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and may a generous spirit support me.”

וְיִשְׂמְחוּ כָּל חוֹסֵי בָךְ לְעוֹלָם יְרַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵךְ עָלֵימוֹ וְיַעַלְצוּ בְךָ אוֹהֲבֵי שְׁמֶךָ. אֶשְׂמְחָה וְאֶעֶלְצָה בָךְ, אֲזַמְּרָה שִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן.


“May all of those who take refuge in You rejoice. May they sing, and You will shelter them. And may all who love Your Name exult in You.” “I will rejoice and be delighted in You; I will sing to Your supernal Name.”

תּוֹדִיעֵנִי אֹרַח חַיִּים שֹׂבַע שְׂמָחוֹת אֶת פָּנֶיךָ, נְעִימוֹת בִּימִינְךָ נֶצַח.


“Let me know the way of life, the satiety of joy before Your countenance, the pleasantness at Your right hand forever.”

בַּיהֹוָה תִּתְהַלֵּל נַפְשִׁי יִשְׁמְעוּ עֲנָוִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ. יָרֹנּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ חֲפֵצֵי צִדְקִי, וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יְהֹוָה הֶחָפֵץ שְׁלוֹם עַבְדּוֹ.


“My soul will praise HaShem. The humble will hear and rejoice.” “Those who desire my vindication will sing and rejoice, and they will always say, ‘May HaShem, Who desires the wellbeing of His servant, be magnified.’”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:6

יָשִׂישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּל מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ, יֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יְהֹוָה אוֹהֲבֵי תְּשׁוּעָתֶךָ.


“May all those who seek You exult and rejoice. May those who love Your salvation always say, ‘May HaShem be made great.’”

וְצַדִּיקִים יִשְׂמְחוּ יַעַלְצוּ לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים וְיָשִׂישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָה.


“May the righteous rejoice, exult before God, and delight in joy.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:8

הֲלֹא אַתָּה תָּשׁוּב תְּחַיֵּינוּ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂמְחוּ בָךְ. שַׂבְּעֵנוּ בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וּנְרַנְּנָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בְּכָל יָמֵינוּ. שַׂמְּחֵנוּ כִּימוֹת עִנִּיתָנוּ שְׁנוֹת רָאִינוּ רָעָה.


“Will You not return and revive us, so that Your nation will rejoice in You?” “Satiate us in the morning with Your lovingkindness, and we will sing and rejoice all of our days. Grant us joy according to the days that You pained us, the years that we saw evil.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:9)


יִשְׂמְחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵל הָאָרֶץ וְיֹאמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם יְהֹוָה מָלָךְ. עִבְדוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה בְּשִׂמְחָה בּוֹאוּ לְפָנָיו בִּרְנָנָה. יֶעֱרַב עָלָיו שִׂיחִי אָנֹכִי אֶשְׂמַח בַּיהֹוָה, הִתְהַלְּלוּ בְּשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂמַח לֵב מְבַקְשֵׁי יְהֹוָה.


“May the heavens rejoice and the earth exult, and may they say among the nations, ‘HaShem has reigned.’” “Serve HaShem with joy, come before Him with singing.” “May my speech be sweet to Him; I will rejoice in HaShem.” “Praise His holy Name; let the heart of those who seek HaShem rejoice.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:10

זָכְרֵנִי יְהֹוָה בִּרְצוֹן עַמֶּךָ פָּקְדֵנִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ. לִרְאוֹת בְּטוֹבַת בְּחִירֶיךָ, לִשְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַת גּוֹיֶךָ, לְהִתְהַלֵּל עִם נַחֲלָתֶךָ.


“Remember me, HaShem, when You favor Your nation. Be mindful of me with Your salvation. May I see the goodness of Your chosen ones, may I rejoice in the joy of Your nation, may I boast with Your inheritance.”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:11)


יִרְאוּ יְשָׁרִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וְכָל עַוְלָה קָפְצָה פִּיהָ. יְקַלְלוּ הֵמָּה וְאַתָּה תְבָרֵךְ, קָמוּ וַיֵּבֹשׁוּ וְעַבְדְּךָ יִשְׂמָח. יְרֵאֶיךָ יִרְאוּנִי וְיִשְׂמָחוּ כִּי לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי. יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֹשָׂיו בְּנֵי־צִיּוֹן יָגִילוּ בְמַלְכָּם:


“The upright will see and rejoice, and all injustice will shut its mouth.” “They will curse, but You will bless; they have risen and experienced shame, but Your servant will rejoice.” “Those who fear You will see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.” “Israel will rejoice in its Maker; the children of Zion will be glad in their King.”

רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, מָלֵא רַחֲמִים, אֲדוֹן הַשִּׂמְחָה וְהַחֶדְוָה, אֲשֶׁר הַשִּׂמְחָה בִּמְעוֹנֶךָ, וְאֵין לְפָנֶיךָ שׁוּם עַצְבוּת כְּלָל, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, הוֹד וְהָדָר לְפָנָיו עֹז וְחֶדְוָה בִּמְקוֹמוֹ,


Master of the world, You Who are filled with compassion, Lord of joy and gladness, You Who have joy in Your dwelling place, there is no sadness at all before You. As the verse states, “Glory and majesty are before Him, might and gladness in His place.”

זַכֵּנִי בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים וּבַחֲסָדֶיךָ הָעֲצוּמִים, שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לִהְיוֹת בְּשִׂמְחָה תָמִיד,


In Your vast compassion and intense lovingkindness, help me be joyful always.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:14

כַּאֲשֶׁר גִּלִּיתָ לָנוּ עַל־יְדֵי צַדִּיקֶיךָ הָאֲמִתִּיִּים שֶׁשִּׂמְחָה הִיא סִטְרָא דִּקְדֻשָּׁה, וְעַצְבוּת וּמָרָה שְׁחוֹרָה הִיא הַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא, וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שׂוֹנֵא אוֹתָהּ,


As You have revealed to us through Your true Tzaddikim, joy is the Side of Holiness, whereas sadness and bitterness are the Other Side — which You, the blessed Holy One, detest.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:15)


וְכָל קְדֻשַּׁת אִישׁ הַיִּשְרְאֵלִי הוּא עַל־יְדֵי שִׂמְחָה דַּיְקָא, וְכָל הַהִתְרַחֲקוּת שֶׁלָּנוּ מִמְּךָ וְהִתְגַּבְּרוּת הַתַּאֲווֹת הַכֹּל הוּא עַל־יְדֵי עַצְבוּת וּמָרָה שְׁחוֹרָה.


The entire holiness of the Jew comes about in particular by means of joy. And all of our alienation from You and the growth of physical desires come about as a result of sadness and bitterness.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:16)


אֲבָל אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ כַּמָּה אֲנִי רָחוֹק מִשִּׂמְחָה, כִּי קִלְקַלְתִּי וּפָגַמְתִּי הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד.


You know how far I am from joy, because I have damaged and destroyed a great deal.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:17)


עַל־כֵּן בָּאתִי לְפָנֶיךָ מָלֵא רַחֲמִים, שֶׁתִּהְיֶה בְּעֶזְרִי וּתְשַׂמְּחֵנִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ, וְתָאִיר בִּי וּתְגַלֶּה לִי דַרְכֵי עֵצוֹתֶיךָ הָאֲמִתִּיּוֹת. וְתוֹרֵנִי וּתְלַמְּדֵנִי שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לַהֲפֹךְ כָּל מִינֵי יָגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְשִׂמְחָה,


Therefore, I come to You Who are filled with compassion, to help me and save me by giving me joy — and with that joy, to illuminate me and reveal to me the ways of Your true counsel, guiding and teaching me to transform every sort of groan and sigh into joy.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:18)


שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיֶה שׁוּם כֹּחַ לְהַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא שֶׁהוּא הַיָּגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְהַכְנִיס בִּי עַצְבוּת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם,


May the Side of Evil, which is expressed in groans and sighs that fill me with sadness, Heaven forbid, have no more power.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:19)


רַק אַדְרַבָּא אֶזְכֶּה בְּכָל עֵת לְהִתְחַזֵּק וּלְהִתְגַּבֵּר בְּשִׂמְחָה גְּדוֹלָה כָּל כָּךְ, עַד שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לַהֲפֹךְ הַיָּגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְשִׂמְחָה, וְלֹא אַנִּיחַ לְהָעַצְבוּת וְהַיָּגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְהִתְאַחֵז בִּי כְּלָל.


To the contrary, at every moment may I strengthen myself and increase my joy so much that I will transform the groans and sighs to joy, and I will not allow the sadness, groans and sighs to retain any hold on me.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:20)


רַק בְּכָל מַה שֶּׁרוֹצִים לְהַכְנִיס בִּי עַצְבוּת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, עַל־יְדֵי רִבּוּי הַחֲטָאִים וְהָעֲוֹנוֹת הָעֲצוּמִים שֶׁעָשִׂיתִי וּפָגַמְתִּי הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד בְּלִי שִׁעוּר, אֶזְכֶּה לַהֲפֹךְ כָּל זֶה לְשִׂמְחָה,


They wish to fill me with sadness, Heaven forbid, by exploiting the many serious transgressions and sins that I have committed, and my many, immeasurable blemishes. Instead, may I transform all of these into joy.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:21)


עַל אֲשֶׁר אַף־עַל־פִּי־כֵן חָמַל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עָלַי, וְשָׂם נַפְשִׁי בַּחַיִּים וְלֹא נָתַן לַמּוֹט רַגְלַי, וְזִכַּנִי לִהְיוֹת בִּכְלַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא עָשַׂנִי גוֹי,


**Performing Mitzvot Every Day**
HaShem, You have had mercy on me and kept my soul alive and not allowed my foot to slip. And You have given me the merit of being a Jew and not a gentile.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:22)


וַאֲנִי זוֹכֶה לְקַיֵּם כַּמָּה מִצְוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת בְּכָל יוֹם וָיוֹם, לְהִתְעַטֵּף בְּצִיצִית, וּלְהָנִיחַ תְּפִלִּין, וְלִקְרוֹת קְרִיאַת שְׁמַע, וּלְקַבֵּל שַׁבָּת וְיוֹם־טוֹב,


Every day, I perform a number of important mitzvot: I wrap myself in tzitzit, put on tefilin and recite the Shema, and I celebrate the Shabbat and festivals.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:23)


וְלִשְׁמֹעַ קוֹל שׁוֹפָר בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה, וּלְהִתְעַנּוֹת בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, וְלֵישֵׁב בַּסֻּכָּה, וְלִטֹּל אַרְבָּעָה מִינִים, וְלֶאֱכֹל מַצָּה בְּפֶּסַח,


On Rosh HaShanah, I hear the sound of the shofar. On Yom Kippur, I fast; on Sukkot, I sit in a sukkah and wave the Four Species; and on Pesach, I eat matzah.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:24)


וְכֵן שַׁאֲרֵי כָּל הַמִּצְוֹת הַקְּדוֹשׁוֹת אֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ עַם קָדְשֶׁךָ מְקַיְּמִים בְּכָל עֵת אֲפִלּוּ הַפָּחוּת שֶׁבַּפְּחוּתִים וְהַקַּל שֶׁבַּקַּלִּים,


And there are all of the other holy mitzvot that we, Your holy nation — even the least of the least and the slightest of the slight — perform all the time.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:25)


מָה רַב טוּבְךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ עִמָּנוּ, מַה יָּקָר חַסְדְּךָ אֱלֹהִים, מַה גָּדְלוּ, מָה רַבּוּ, מֶה עָצְמוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ וַחֲסָדֶיךָ עָלֵינוּ, אֲשֶׁר הִכְתַּרְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ בִּכְתָרִים קְדוֹשִׁים כָּאֵלֶּה,


How vast is the goodness that You have done on our behalf! “How precious is Your lovingkindness, God!” Your compassion and lovingkindness toward us have grown, increased and intensified. They are holy crowns with which You have crowned us.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:26)


וּבְתֹקֶף גָּלוּתֵינוּ וְעֹצֶם הִתְרַחֲקוּתֵנוּ מִמְּךָ עַל־יְדֵי רִבּוּי פְּשָׁעֵינוּ נֶגְדְּךָ, עֲדַיִן אַהֲבָתְךָ קְשׁוּרָה בָּנוּ, וְאַתָּה מְזַכֶּה גַם אוֹתִי לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּמָּה מִצְוֹת בְּכָל יוֹם,


Despite our exile and our great distance from You as a result of the multitude of our offenses against You, Your love is still connected to us, and You make it possible for me to perform a number of mitzvot every day.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:27)


וּבְוַדַּאי רָאוּי לִי לְהַגְדִּיל הַשִּׂמְחָה בְּכָל עֵת, וְלַהֲפֹךְ כָּל הַיָּגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְשִׂמְחָה, כִּי אַדְרַבָּא, זֶהוּ שִׂמְחָתִי, שֶׁמְּרֻחָק וּפָגוּם וְחוֹטֵא כָּמוֹנִי יִזְכֶּה לִגַּע בִּדְבָרִים קְדוֹשִׁים וְנוֹרָאִים כָּאֵלֶּה,


It is certainly fitting for me to increase my joy at every moment and transform all of my groans and sighs to joy. That itself is my joy: that a person as distant from You as myself, as blemished and sinful as I am, can touch upon such holy and awesome matters.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:28)


לְיַחֵד שִׁמְךָ בְכָל יוֹם, וּלְהִתְעַטֵּר בַּעֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת הַתְּפִלִּין הַקְּדוֹשִׁים וְהַנּוֹרָאִים בְּכָל יוֹם, וּלְהִתְעַטֵּף בְּצִיצִית, לְהִתְלַבֵּשׁ בִּלְבוּשִׁין דְּמַלְכָּא בְּעִטּוּפָא דְמִצְוָה, וּשְׁאָר הַמִּצְוֹת,


This includes unifying Your Name every day, being crowned in the beautiful crown of the holy, awesome tefilin, wrapping myself in tzitzit, wearing the garments of the King when I wrap myself in this mitzvah, and other mitzvot.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:29)


וְכָל מַה שֶּׁרוֹצִים לְהִתְגַּבֵּר לְהַכְנִיס בְּדַעְתִּי וְלִבִּי עַצְבוּת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, מֵרִבּוּי פְּשָׁעַי וַעֲוֹנוֹתַי, עַל־יְדֵי כָּל זֶה דַּיְקָא אַגְדִּיל הַשִּׂמְחָה, וְאוֹמַר לְלִבִּי: אַדְרַבָּא, זֶהוּ שִׂמְחָתִי, זֶהוּ חֶדְוָתִי הַגְּדוֹלָה, שֶׁאָנֹכִי הַמְרֻחָק כָּל־כָּךְ זוֹכֶה לִגַּע בִּקְדֻשּׁוֹת כָּאֵלֶּה,


Precisely when the multitude of my offenses and sins desires to overcome my heart and mind and fill them with sadness, Heaven forbid, may I increase my joy and tell my heart that, to the contrary, this is my joy, this is my greatest gladness: that I, who am so far from You, am able to touch such holinesses.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:30)


הֱקִיצוֹתִי וְעוֹדִי עִמָּךְ, כִּי דִּכִּיתָנוּ בִּמְקוֹם תַּנִּים וַתְּכַס עָלֵינוּ בְצַלְמָוֶת, אִם שָׁכַחְנוּ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַנִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפֵּינוּ לְאֵל זָר, אֲנִי לְדוֹדִי וְדוֹדִי לִי, אֲחַזְנוּךָ וְלֹא נַרְפֶּךָּ:


**Joy Through Song**
“I came to the end [of the generations], and I am still with you.” “You crushed us in a place of serpents and covered us in a deathly shadow.” Even if “we forgot the name of our God and spread out our palms to a foreign god,” “I am my Beloved’s and my Beloved is mine.” I have taken hold of You and I will not let You go.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:31)


מָרָא דְעַלְמָא כֹּלָּא, שִׂמְחַת יִשְׂרָאֵל, שַׂמֵּחַ נֶפֶשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוָה נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּׂא.


Master of the entire world, Joy of Israel, “Give joy to the soul of Your servant — because, HaShem, I lift my soul to You!”


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:32)


זַכֵּנִי לְהַשִּׂיג בֶּאֱמֶת דַּרְכֵי הַשִּׂמְחָה הָאֲמִתִּיִּית, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁאֶזְכֶּה לַחֲטֹף הַיָּגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְתוֹךְ הַשִּׂמְחָה, לַהֲפֹךְ כָּל מִינֵי עַצְבוּת וְיָגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה לְשִׂמְחָה.


Help me truly attain the genuine ways of joy, so that I will pull the moans and sighs into that joy and transform every type of sadness, moans and sighs into joy.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:33)


זַכֵּנִי לְהִתְחַזֵּק וּלְהִתְגַּבֵּר בְּשִׂמְחָה גְּדוֹלָה תָמִיד, וְאֶזְכֶּה לְהַמְשִׁיךְ עָלַי קְדֻשַּׁת כָּל הָעֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה שֶׁהֵם כְּלָלִיוּת הַשִּׂמְחָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה.


May I always strengthen myself and increase my joy. Help me draw the holiness of all ten types of melody, which constitute the totality of holy joy, onto myself.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Likutei%20Tefilot/s/Volume%20II/r/21:34)


וְתַרְגִּילֵנִי לְשַׂמֵּחַ אֶת נַפְשִׁי בְּכָל־עֵת עַל־יְדֵי נִגּוּן שֶׁל שִׂמְחָה, וְאָגִיל וְאֶשְׂמַח בַּיהֹוָה בְּשִׁיר וְהַלֵּל וְרַנֵּן וְזִמְרָה וְנִגּוּן, וְאֶזְכֶּה לִהְיוֹת בְּשִׂמְחָה תָמִיד,


Accustom me to gladden my soul at every moment with joyful melody. May I delight and rejoice in You, HaShem, with song, praise, music and melody. May I always experience joy.


###### Likutei Tefilot, Volume II 21:35
